I can't add this to the programme. The WPL-AI format I emit only defines workout structures (TYPE workout, phases, weeks, days, exercises, cardio). It has no syntax for meals, foods, macros or nutrition targets, so any nutrition block I wrote would be made-up syntax and the compiler would reject it.

**Options:**

1. **Keep the workout plan as is.** The 12-week programme I sent already avoids HIIT, heavy Valsalva and jumping on all flow days (May 31–Jun 3, Jun 27–30, Jul 24–27, Aug 20–23) and flare days (Jul 10–13, Aug 4–7). It is unchanged and still compiles.
2. **Use your platform's nutrition format.** If it supports nutrition plans (for example a separate TYPE with its own syntax), send me the spec and I'll write a matching anti-inflammatory plan.
3. **Get guidance outside the plan.** I can write a separate anti-inflammatory eating guide, not in WPL-AI, for you to share with the client. It would cover:
   * a Mediterranean-style pattern
   * omega-3-rich fish
   * fibre and whole grains
   * colourful vegetables and fruit
   * limited ultra-processed food and alcohol
   * enough iron around flow days

Since she has Stage III endometriosis, I'd suggest referring her to a registered dietitian for individual nutrition advice, especially if she has gut symptoms, which are common with endometriosis.
